EdgeGeometryKind.description: How every edge in one snapshot is shaped.

oneOf.description: No columns: endpoints derive from node geometry, so straight edges cost zero bytes.
CSR-shaped `offsets[]` (m+1) and `pts[]`: layered bends, orthogonal routes, bundles.
`offsets[]`, `pts[]` and a degree tag: bezier and quadratic styles, FDEB output.

major.description: Incremented on any change an older reader would misread.

minor.description: Incremented on additive changes an older reader can safely ignore.

NodeGeometryKind.description: How every node in one snapshot is shaped.

oneOf.description: Columns `x[]`, `y[]`: force, spectral, MDS, circular, grid, geographic.
Columns `x[]`, `y[]`, `w[]`, `h[]`: treemap, matrix cell, layered node.

description: The fixed-size head of every snapshot: one geometry discriminant for the whole payload.

dim.description:
How many dimensions every node of the snapshot carries: `0` 2D with no z column,
`1` 3D with one. Once for the whole payload, so the node section's length follows
from this and the node kind alone. `2..=255` is reserved and refused.

edge_kind.description: Shape of every edge in the snapshot.

node_count.description: Number of nodes, and the length of every node column.

node_kind.description: Shape of every node in the snapshot.

stage_count.description: Named geometries carried for one topology. Reserved: exactly `1` until implemented.

version.description: Format version the payload was written with.

title: SnapshotHeader
